rationale: C05-N007 remains primary owner of σ-algebra, measure and Lebesgue integration. C07-T01 specializes an accepted measure space to a probability measure of total mass one without re-authoring generic measure theory.
Expectation and conditional expectation in C07 consume accepted measurable-function/Lebesgue-integration foundations; C07 owns probability semantics, not generic integration foundations.
C01 owns generic functions/relations; C07 specializes measurable maps as random variables.
C03 owns matrix/vector-space primitives. C07 uses them to interpret covariance matrices without re-authoring linear algebra.
C07 probability convergence and LLN/CLT reuse accepted analytic limit/measure foundations while owning probabilistic convergence modes and theorem statements.
Descriptive summaries characterize observed data; estimation/testing add sampling-model guarantees. The objectives remain distinct rather than treating descriptive patterns as inference.
C07 owns mathematical/statistical descriptive meanings. Future B1.5-C07 owns data models, databases/pipelines and computational data-science objectives; no future claim supports C07.

C07 owns estimators, likelihood, information and inferential guarantees. Future B1.5 scopes own computational pipelines, model engineering and machine-learning systems; they provide zero support Claim IDs.
C07 may define an MLE mathematically as an argmax but does not author numerical optimization procedures. Locked C10 owns broader numerical/applied optimization and supplies zero support claims.
C07 owns hypothesis-test calibration and mathematical inference. Future AI/model-evaluation pipelines and implementation remain B1.5-C10; no future claim supports C07.
C07 owns Bayesian probability/inference mathematics. Bayesian computation inside AI systems, model engineering and deployment remain future B1.5-C10.

Probability/statistics are mathematical dependencies of AI, but B1.5-C10 remains primary B1 owner of AI computation. This secondary link does not author AI cognition, system engineering, ethics, policy or applications and transfers no ownership.
Experimental design supplies random-assignment and design-based identification conditions; T10 owns causal estimands, assumptions and causal inference semantics.

C08 remains primary owner of generic DAG, topological-order and reachability mathematics. C07-T10 adds causal semantics, Markov/d-separation assumptions, interventions and identification; a DAG alone is not causal evidence.
C07 owns causal identification mathematics. Predictive/AI model accuracy, pipelines and system engineering remain future B1.5-C10; prediction is not causation and supplies no C07 support claims.

Frequentist confidence/estimation use sampling-distribution calibration; Bayesian posterior/credible semantics use prior-likelihood conditioning. Shared probability foundations do not make the learning objectives identical.
p-values/type-I error calibration remain frequentist; posterior probabilities/Bayes factors remain Bayesian. Neither is silently reinterpreted as the other.
